description: HappyFares is India's AI-powered flight booking platform, now inside ChatGPT. Ask conversationally Cheap flights Delhi to Bangalore next weekend and get live fares in a rich card UI. Meera AI tells you whether prices will rise or fall, suggests cheaper nearby dates, surfaces alternate airports, and lets you set a price alert in one click. Group fares (7+ pax), refundable filter, and pre-filled booking links to happyfares.in for a seamless checkout. 40 lakh+ travellers trust HappyFares
